features: Day/night with automatically removable IR-cut filter
Outdoor-ready camera in IP66/NEMA 4X, IK10 aluminium enclosure with sunshield
Operation down to -40 C with High PoE
Varifocal P-Iris CS-mount lens (DC-iris lenses also supported)
5 MP at 12 fps; 3 MP at 20 fps; 30 fps in HDTV 1080p and 2 MP capture modes
Two-way full-duplex audio via 3.5 mm mic/line in and line out

power.method: PoE (IEEE 802.3af, max 12.95 W) or High PoE (max 25.5 W)

storage.notes: SD/SDHC memory card slot (card not included)

release_notes: Specs per official Axis user manual (axis-p1347-e--user-manual-en-US-47771.pdf). Operating temperature -30 to 50 C with PoE (down to -40 C with High PoE); consumption_w is the High PoE maximum.

frigate.notes: Standard Axis VAPIX RTSP path; not yet verified on this model.

home_assistant.notes: Native Axis integration with auto-discovery via Zeroconf.
